title: Warm Wilted Portuguese Wrap
description: A delicious gluten-free wrap filled with warm wilted Portuguese greens and herbal flavors.
instructions: 1. Wash the Portuguese kale and remove the stems.
2. Heat the herbal olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
3. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
4. Add the kale to the pan and cook until wilted.
5. Squeeze the lemon juice over the kale and season with salt.
6. Warm the wrap in the microwave or in a dry pan.
7. Fill the wrap with the wilted kale mixture.
